title: Align your Latents: High-Resolution Video Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models
grouping: Two matching scenes left and right joined by a large dark block arrow labelled 'Temporal Video Fine-Tuning' in a serif face. Each scene is one 3-D box whose depth is sliced into frames along a thick dark arrow labelled 'Batch/Video Frame Axis'; serif callout boxes with thin black borders name the noise inputs and the denoising direction. A sentence below each scene states what it shows.
shapes_depth: The volumes are drawn in perspective with dark faces, a magenta-to-yellow glow and coloured stochastic trajectories (blue, green, cyan lines with circle markers) running through the slices; on the right, the trajectories meet at one row of red-linked markers. Bell-shaped density curves in a dark gradient hang off the volume sides. Photographic frame samples fan out from the volume as overlapping tilted thumbnails, each tied to a trajectory point by a thin peach arrow.
proposed_highlight: The effect of the method is the contrast between the two scenes: the left fan of thumbnails is a set of unrelated images, the right fan is the same subject in successive frames; the right volume's trajectories converge on a red-linked line. The method's step is the large arrow between the scenes.
lesson: Show temporal alignment as a before/after pair of identical 3-D volumes whose depth axis is labelled as the frame axis, with sample frames fanning out of each: unrelated images before, one coherent clip after.
notes: Venue CVPR from Semantic Scholar title match. Figure 2 rather than Figure 1 (Fig. 1 is a sample grid); it is a concept figure placed beside the introduction and works as the paper's teaser diagram. Annotation note (2026-11-15): conceptual illustration rather than an architecture diagram; crop clips the top label

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

insights.structure: Before/after diptych: two identical 3-D boxes of stacked frame slices (diffusion time vs batch/frame axis) with a large dark 'Temporal Video Fine-Tuning' arrow between them, each captioned below.
insights.data: Denoising trajectories are coloured noisy curves through the box ending in coloured dots, the marginal distribution is a purple density curve on the box side, and real generated frames fan out above (noisy) and below (clean samples).
insights.emphasis: The contrast is in the samples: unrelated images on the left versus a consistent panda sequence on the right, plus red connecting links between the final dots in the right box.
insights.flow: Left to right across the central arrow; within each box, top-to-bottom from noise to data, with peach arrows fanning from dots to sample thumbnails.
insights.avoid: Highly decorative 3-D boxes with many thin peach arrows; the crop cuts off the top label and the mechanism (which layers are added) is not shown.

arrangement.units: two unframed 3-D diffusion boxes (before / after), captioned below, joined by a big block arrow
arrangement.inputs_as: noisy image frames and labelled text boxes for noise
